name: SaffronERC20StakingPool
title: The Saffron Ghost of Berlin
tagline: A friendly staking pool that fell silent under the Berlin moon.

chapters.heading: The birth of the saffron pool
paragraphs: Candles flicker over the SaffronERC20StakingPool. It was born on July 10, 2021. A wallet ending in f8cb brought it into the world. On the day it was born it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book.
The contract is a small program that lives on Ethereum. It arrived during the Berlin era. It was built using Solidity 0.7.4. Now it has lived for 5.3 years.

chapters.heading: The quiet hum of the pool
paragraphs: People came to the SaffronERC20StakingPool to move their wealth. They called to add liquidity and remove liquidity. Some joined the governance to guide the way.
The contract saw 30 transactions in its life. It moved through new epochs before falling still. Its busy days ended in 2021.

chapters.heading: The long silence
paragraphs: The saffron pool fell still on August 8, 2021. Someone called remove_liquidity and the movement stopped. It has been quiet for 5.2 years.
The code still rests on the chain like a shadow. It holds 0.0 ETH inside its empty heart.
